canonical_project: Himachal Pradesh State Data Centre (SDC), Mehli
owner: Government of Himachal Pradesh - IT Department
notes: CM Virbhadra Singh inaugurated the HP State Data Centre and new IT department building at Mehli, Shimla on 4 June 2016; it was described as India's first 'green' data centre, built at a cost of Rs 58 crore to host e-governance applications (101 services via Lok Mitra Kendras, HIMSWAN connectivity). MW capacity not disclosed. The Tribune (Oct 2025) separately reports an IT park at Mehli, Shimla targeted for completion by Dec 2025, adjacent infrastructure rather than a distinct DC.
